caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a dog standing on a rectangular green base. The dog is oriented in profile, facing toward the left side of the image, with its head slightly raised and ears relaxed. The dog’s body is primarily brown, with the front half covered in an intricately textured, crosshatched pattern that suggests a protective or decorative garment. This patterned section covers the head, neck, shoulders, upper back, and front legs, ending just behind the shoulder and at the upper forelegs. The rest of the body, including the hindquarters and tail, is smooth and unadorned, rendered in a shaded brown tone. The tail is curled upward and the entire figure casts a subtle shadow onto the surface below. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or detailed elements. The artist’s name, "MINA LOWRY," is written in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Poodle
